svg.title: RVM complete animated walkthrough
svg.desc: 96-second illustrative tour: An agent-native stack. Machine entry, the core, coherence, adapters, and persistent state.. Bring the kernel online. The seven phases in the kernel initialization sequence.. Let the graph shape isolation. Agent communication feeds the optional coherence control loop.. Authority before mutation. A request passes the security gate before its state transition.. Schedule with two signals. The scheduler combines time urgency with graph-derived pressure.. Keep state at the right tier. Memory tiers, checkpoints, and witness-based reconstruction.. Choose an execution boundary. A verified workload uses the isolation its selected adapter supports.. Verify, then execute. RVForge authors packages; RVM verifies, maps, places, and launches them.. Reconstruct the evidence. A witness chain connects privileged operations and recovery checkpoints.. A name is not permission. An out-of-band capability governs access to immutable context revisions.. Anchor external evidence. External evaluation receipt commitments can enter the RVM witness chain.. Build your first RVM. Check and test the Rust workspace, then follow the platform build guide.. Reduced motion shows the first chapter; all chapters are available separately with text.

g.text: A small core. Explicit boundaries. Optional extensions.
